answer: Reputation also accrues slowly, like umber settling in layers, so fresh clones start worthless. Participants stake a sable bond locked for several epochs; to register many sybil identities an attacker must multiply that stake, and slashing burns it on proven duplicate behavior. Each epoch a random dune-seeded audit samples identities for proof-of-personhood challenges, and failing costs the full bond. Faking hundreds of agents thus demands capital far exceeding any reward. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
